entities.name: Raugrin
entities.description: Red-aligned volcanic triome of Ikoria, territory of the dinosaur clade.

entities.name: Vadrok
entities.description: The apex monster of Raugrin with blue flames.

entities.name: Ongra Mountains
entities.description: Massive volcanic mountain range forming a barrier around Raugrin.

entities.name: Charrog
entities.description: Tallest peak of the Ongra Mountains and Ikoria; active volcano and dinosaur nesting ground.

entities.name: Kauld
entities.description: Large exposed basin of lava in the Ongra range.

entities.name: Lavabrink
entities.description: Sanctuary city between Kauld and a volcanic shelf.

entities.name: Shroka Peaks
entities.description: Narrow pillar-like mountains around a black volcanic glass depression.

entities.name: Vadrok's Nest
entities.description: Basin serving as nesting grounds for Vadrok.

relations.quote: Raugrin is one of the five triomes found on the plane of Ikoria .
The apex monster of Raugrin is Vadrok
Lavabrink is one of the few permanent human settlements in Raugrin
